title: Combat & stuff
description: This mod adds several new tools and things to make combat more interesting.
body:
This mod adds several new tools and things to make combat more interesting.

The hammer is a new weapon that deals a whopping 15 damage, while the weapon has an attack speed of 0.5. When you right-click on a block, all mobs standing above it are briefly launched, which deals massive damage to them.

![Hammer craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8144fc950128598263b5a2ab568f85909f757cc8.png)

The mace is a weapon that deals 10 damage and has an attack speed of 1.5. Right-clicking an entity causes it to freeze for a short time.

![Mace craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1192a551e686a50bfc4e87a4a00b8296f18199f4.png)

The Grass Shield works like a normal shield, but when you press the Z key, it makes you dash.

![Grass shiled craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a60b277d65ea57f7867b0119e4938f70736246f.png)

From a shard of amethyst and prismarine you can create a crystal of return, thanks to which you can return to the spawn point.

![Rerurn crystal craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1daf28971a8dd321ddef3203f200b6104277982a.png)
![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f93c300691f0153ed3ffb65e91f741799775d56.png)
